meta.title: Usage Stats
meta.description: Multi-provider usage stats (v2 adapter contract): floating capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official, OpenCode Go and Zhipu Coding Plan adapters built in.

en.customProvHint: These providers are absent from the dsh model page (not selectable yet — register the adapter first; they count separately from the list above).
en.errAdapterLoadFailed: Custom adapter failed to load — check the file path and contract (details on the settings page).
en.errBadData: Malformed data — check the provider API or adapter output.
en.errBusy: Previous fetch still in progress, refreshing shortly.
en.errHttpStatus: Service returned {code} — check the relay status.
en.errNetwork: Network error, check the connection and retry.
en.errNoAdapter: No adapter configured for this provider — add one under Usage statistics.
en.errNoApiKey: API key not found (set the {p}_API_KEY environment variable or .credentials.yaml).
en.errNoEnabledAdapter: This provider has candidate adapters but none enabled — enable one under Usage statistics.
en.filePathOnly: (the only input — name/display name/providers are read from the file exports)
en.historySub: Expand for detail · loaded on demand
en.noAdapterHint: Enable a candidate adapter under Usage statistics, or copy the guide prompt below and let an agent wire up the data source.
en.noAdapterTitle: No enabled adapter for this provider.
en.noCandidates: No candidate adapters for this provider — inject a local adapter file via [+ Add adapter] below, or copy the guide prompt and let an agent create one.
en.noProvHint: No configured provider found (adapters.json unreachable or none configured on the model page). Copy the guide prompt and let an agent wire up a data source.
en.pathKeyHint: Local .mjs only · keys never reach the client
en.pillNotConfigured: No adapter configured — click for onboarding
en.provListHint: Provider list mirrors the model configuration page ({n} total); expand a provider to switch adapters or add new ones.
en.provSub: Collapsed by default · keys never reach the client
en.reportDirectoriesEmpty: No directory data yet — directories appear here once sessions produce usage.
en.reportDirectoriesHintScoped: Reports include the directory breakdown of selected directories only (other dimensions stay full).
en.reportEmpty: No reports yet — configure a schedule or generate one now
en.reportFilterEmpty: No reports under this filter — switch filter or view all
en.reportGeneratedNotVisible: Report generated but not in the list yet — reload to check.
en.reportGenIdempotentHint: Reuses the existing successful report for the window by default; check Force to overwrite.
en.reportModelFallback: Model list unavailable or empty — falling back to manual input.
en.reportNoData: No usage in this period — nothing generated
en.reportPromptHint: Edit by section, save as a whole; hard constraints folded by default.
en.reportPromptRawHint: Non-standard template — editing as a whole, no text lost
en.reportRangeVarNote: {range} is the window-range injection point (read-only, do not rename)
en.reportReasoningCapabilityError: Reasoning-effort capabilities are temporarily unavailable; the saved setting is preserved.
en.reportReasoningStale: The saved reasoning effort is not advertised by this model; generation will fail closed.
en.reportReasoningUnavailable: This model does not advertise reasoning-effort capabilities.
en.reportRetryAttempt: Current report attempt {attempt}; automatic retry limit {maxAttempts}.
en.reportRetryBusy: A report attempt is already running; costs below are cumulative for this cycle.
en.reportRetryDeferred: The current attempt did not finish; another automatic retry is scheduled.
en.reportRetryHint: Generation failed — retry; check “Regenerate” to overwrite an existing report.
en.reportRetryRunning: Report attempt is running; costs below are cumulative for this cycle.
en.reportReused: Report already exists for this window — reused (check "Regenerate" to overwrite)
en.reportStatsVarNote: {stats} is the stats JSON injection point (read-only, do not rename)
en.reportStillGenerating: Still generating in background — refresh the list later
en.reportWeakModelNote: Monthly reports are long; weaker models may degrade or fail — retry, or switch models and regenerate.
en.trendCaliberModelNote: Splitting by model requires host support (the /trend directory face ignores the by-model parameter) — unavailable for now.
en.trendCaliberNote: Includes the ongoing bucket · tail bucket incomplete
en.trendDetailHint: Tap or hover a bucket in the chart for details
en.trendEmptyHint: Trends for recent usage will appear here once sessions produce usage.
en.trendLegendLabel: Legend — toggling does not rescale the Y axis
en.trendLegendToggleHint: Click a legend item to toggle its segment
en.trendNarrowHint: The available width is too small to draw a readable chart — the root cause is the host settings dialog's content column, which plugins cannot change, so this can only degrade here. The summary and legend below remain usable.
en.trendNarrowSuggest: Try a coarser granularity (week/month) to reduce the bucket count, or open the full chart on a desktop window.
en.uiSavedOk: Saved — pill placement takes effect immediately (all devices)
en.usageHeatNote: Shades are relative to the window maximum
en.usageToday: Today overview (/trend daily; fetch failure does not affect status dots below)
